SimpleProduct:14868.name: Daycare Drink Bottles
SimpleProduct:14868.meta_title: Personalised Daycare Drink Bottle | Customised water bottle for kids
SimpleProduct:14868.meta_description: Keep hydrated with our range of personalised daycare drink bottles for kids, with fun designs and leakproof tops. Create your drink bottle online here!
SimpleProduct:14868.faq:
What age group is this drink bottle for?

This drink bottle is ideal for kids aged 2+.

Help! My flip lid has come off the bottle

You can easily reattach the flip lid by popping it over the hold bumps, just make sure to place it on the right way as per our image gallery to avoid any leakages.

Is the drink bottle safe to use in my steriliser?

Unfortunately it's not safe to use in a steriliser, however it can be hand washed in warm soapy water or placed in the top rack of the dishwasher.

Does it fit inside your range of lunch bags?

Yes! It comfortably fits inside our range of lunch bags with plenty of room for other food items.

Can I get it printed without my child's name?

Yes we can print it without a name and just the design. Simply enter some spaces in the name section and our production team will print your order without personalisation.

description.html:
This daycare drink bottle is perfect for little ones to take to school or activities. The easy-to-open, leak-proof lid keeps drinks secure, and the fun designs now wrap right around the bottle so they’re visible from every side. With plenty of cute options for boys and girls, it pairs perfectly with our matching Daycare Backpacks and other School Supplies.

Your child's name and favourite design will be custom printed directly onto the hard plastic bottle and is so durable that it will easily withstand the rough and tumble of life with kids! It can be hand washed in warm soapy water or placed in the top rack of the dishwasher. We don't recommend using it in a steriliser.

Daycare Drink Bottle Size: 6.5cm wide x 17cm high (2.5" x 6.6").
